title: Role Model’s ‘Chuck Timely & The Hourglass’ Makes Top 10 Debut on 6 Billboard Album Charts
summary: Among its arrivals are a No. 2 bow on Top Album Sales and Vinyl Albums.
contentText:
Role Model ’s third full-length studio album, Chuck Timely & The Hourglass , debuts in the top 10 across six Billboard charts dated Aug. 22, including Top Album Sales . The set launches with the singer-songwriter’s best sales week yet — 24,000 copies sold in the United States in the week ending Aug. 13, according to Luminate.

The new project hits the top 10 on Top Album Sales (No. 2), Vinyl Albums (No. 2), Top Rock & Alternative Albums (No. 3), Top Alternative Albums (No. 3), Indie Store Album Sales (No. 9) and the Billboard 200 . The album’s first-week sales were aided by its availability across 12 physical variants (CD, vinyl and cassette, including signed editions), alongside a pair of download variations.

Elsewhere on the Top Album Sales chart, Stray Kids’ THIS & THAT debuts at No. 1 with the group’s best sales week yet (357,000) and clocks the act its ninth leader. Also shaking up the top 10: Sleep Token’s instrumentals editions of the Even In Arcadia (No. 8, largely supported by vinyl sales), Ethel Cain’s Preacher’s Daughter (a reentry at No. 9 after the album arrived on CD for the first time) and Steve Lacy’s Oh yeah? (a reentry at No. 10 after its CD and vinyl hit stores).

Billboard ’s Top Album Sales chart ranks the top-selling albums of the week based only on pure album sales (physical and digital download purchases combined). The chart’s history dates to May 25, 1991, the first week Billboard began tabulating charts with electronically monitored piece count information from SoundScan, now Luminate. Pure album sales were the sole measurement utilized by the Billboard 200 albums chart through the list dated Dec. 6, 2014, after which that chart switched to a methodology that blends album sales with track equivalent album (TEA) units and streaming equivalent album (SEA) units.
